description: This header file provides utility functions for file operations and string processing within the Utils namespace. It includes functions to read property values from configuration files, read entire file contents, check if a path is a regular file, search files and directories recursively with pattern matching, and expand variables within strings using property values from a file.

methods.name: bool readPropertyFromFile(const char * filename,const string & property,string & propertyValue)
methods.description: Reads a specific property value from a file, supporting recursive expansion if the property value starts with '$'.

methods.name: bool readFileContent(const char * filename,string & content)
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into a string.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)
methods.description: Checks whether a given path is a regular file.

methods.name: bool searchFilesRec(std::vector<std::string> & pathList,unsigned int currentDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Recursively searches directories and files matching patterns, with support for exclusions and depth limits; caps results at 10 entries.

methods.name: bool searchFiles(string & inputPath,int maxDepth,int minDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Initiates a recursive file and directory search starting from a given path.

methods.name: bool ExpandPropertiesInString(const char * input,const char * filePath,string & expandedString)
methods.description: Processes a string to replace variable placeholders with their corresponding values from a properties file.
